Cumulative incidence plot for competing risks

Source: R/cuminc_plot.R
cuminc_plot.Rd

Estimate and plot the cumulative incidence of one event in the presence of competing events, with optional group comparison using Gray's test.

Usage

cuminc_plot(
  data,
  time,
  event,
  event_of_interest,
  censor_code = 0,
  by = NULL,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  p_value = TRUE,
  p_value_position = NULL,
  break_time_by = NULL,
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  xlab = "Time",
  ylab = "Cumulative incidence",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  legend_title = NULL,
  legend_position = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  y_percent = TRUE,
  theme = "classic",
  grid = FALSE,
  base_size = 13
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing follow-up time and event status.

time

Follow-up time. Quoted and bare column names are accepted.

event

Event-status variable with one censoring code and distinct codes for each event type. Quoted and bare column names are accepted.

event_of_interest

Code or label for the event to plot. This must be an observed value of `event` and must differ from `censor_code`.

censor_code

Code or label identifying censored observations. Defaults to `0`.

by

Optional single grouping variable. When supplied, separate curves are drawn and Gray's test compares groups for the event of interest. Groups are ordered by factor level (as in km_plot()).

conf.int

Logical; show pointwise 95 percent confidence intervals.

p_value

Logical; display Gray's test p-value when `by` is supplied.

p_value_position

Optional numeric vector of length two giving the x and y coordinates of the p-value annotation.

break_time_by

Optional positive interval for x-axis breaks.

xlim, ylim

Optional numeric vectors of length two, given as c(lower, upper), defining plot limits. The plot is zoomed to these limits; no data are removed.

xlab, ylab

Axis labels.

title, subtitle, caption

Optional plot text.

legend_title

Optional legend title. The display label of `by` is used by default.

legend_position

One of `"bottom"`, `"top"`, `"right"`, `"left"`, or `"none"`.

palette

Optional character vector of curve colors.

y_percent

Logical; display cumulative incidence as percentages.

theme

One of `"classic"`, `"minimal"`, `"bw"`, or `"light"`.

grid

Logical; show major grid lines.

base_size

Base font size.

Value

A `ggplot2` object with attributes `fit`, `plot_data`, `gray_test`, `event_of_interest`, and `censor_code`.

Details

Cumulative incidence estimates the absolute probability of the selected event over time while correctly retaining competing events in the risk process. Treating competing events as ordinary censoring with a Kaplan-Meier curve generally overestimates event probability.

Gray's test compares cumulative-incidence functions between groups. It is a group comparison and not an adjusted effect estimate; use `competing_risk_reg()` when a subdistribution hazard ratio is required.

Examples

cuminc_plot(
  data_competing_risk,
  time = follow_up_months,
  event = outcome,
  event_of_interest = Relapse,
  censor_code = Censored,
  by = treatment
)
